note: The frozen half of the task. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its OWN copy of it at grading time, and tests/Dockerfile refuses to build unless the two copies are byte-identical.

architecture.note: The shape is frozen. `default_logit_softcap` is the upstream constant and is recorded here as provenance only: in this slot the cap is one of the controls a policy sets, and it reaches the decoder as a run-time tensor.

budget.note: The compute budget is FIXED in tokens and in forward and backward passes. No policy can change how many micro-batches are run or how they are grouped, so every policy costs the same FLOPs and very nearly the same wall clock.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.note: FROZEN, and deliberately a GOOD recipe rather than a weak one. The four per-role peak learning rates, every AdamW constant, the clip and the whole warmup-hold-decay envelope are fixed by the task. This slot does not grade optimizer or schedule tuning -- those axes are already spent -- it grades what is left: how the objective is regularised and how the 50304-way output distribution is shaped. Note what is ABSENT from this block: weight_decay. Decay is decoupled from the optimizer's other constants precisely because it is one of the things a policy sets, and it is set PER PARAMETER ROLE rather than once.

objective.training_loss: (1 - label_smoothing) * mean NLL + label_smoothing * mean uniform NLL + z_loss * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2)
objective.graded_loss: plain mean token-level cross entropy through the same logit softcap the run trained under
objective.note: The training objective and the graded reading are DIFFERENT functions on purpose. Smoothing and the log-partition penalty are training-time regularisers; the reading is the unsmoothed, unpenalised cross entropy. A policy that helps the training loss and hurts the reading is a policy that scores worse, and that asymmetry is the whole tension of this slot.

init.note: Every run in this task starts from the same parameter tensors. The policy is the only thing that differs between two runs.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different training shard and is the agent's own yardstick; it is never the graded number.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
